# SmashChill
> Free online stress relief arcade games, anti-stress mini-games, and mindful ASMR web toys for students, remote workers, and gamers worldwide.

## Online Arcade Games
- [1v1 Smash Duel](https://smashchill.online/#duel): Real-time multiplayer decompression battles with local 2P split-screen and online room invite codes.
- [Hydraulic Press Crusher](https://smashchill.online/#press): 10,000 PSI industrial squashing physics.
- [Pop-It 3D Fidget](https://smashchill.online/#popit): 36-bubble rainbow silicone sensory toy with perspective board flip.
- [Stress Ninja](https://smashchill.online/#ninja): Kinetic gadget slicing action with multi-slice combos.
- [Kinetic Sand ASMR](https://smashchill.online/#sand): Layered rainbow sand carving with acoustic crunchy slices.
- [Newton's Cradle](https://smashchill.online/#newton): Harmonic collision physics with momentum transfer.
- [Soap Slicer ASMR](https://smashchill.online/#soap): Kinetic textured soap carving with crisp audio feedback.
- [Slap Dummy](https://smashchill.online/#slap): High-tension spring ragdoll slap physics.
- [Virtual Rage Room](https://smashchill.online/#smash): Cathartic office monitor and printer demolition.
- [Bubble Wrap Pop](https://smashchill.online/#bubble): Tactile sensory bubble wrap popping.
- [Koi Zen Pond](https://smashchill.online/#zen): Mindful Kyoto water sanctuary with swimming koi and blooming lotus flowers.
- [Rant Shredder](https://smashchill.online/#shredder): Emotional cognitive venting, shredding, and digital burning.
